meta.title: 小心，你刚建的知识库可能正在贬值
meta.title_en: Careful — Your New Knowledge Base Is Depreciating
meta.topic: 知识管理 · AI 时代的知识库反思

scenes.title_en: Six Years of Notes, Then Giving Up
scenes.context: 做了 6 年笔记、深度使用 AI 知识库一年多，却选择放弃第二大脑，因为 1000 条笔记里真正有用的不到 50 条。
sentences: 我做了 6 年笔记，深度使用 AI 知识库一年多。
I kept notes for six years and used an AI knowledge base deeply for over a year.
knowledge base（知识库）
在全网吹捧第二大脑时，我却选择了放弃。
While everyone was hyping the second brain, I chose to walk away.
second brain（第二大脑）
我存了 1000 条笔记，真正有用的不到 50 条。
I saved a thousand notes — fewer than fifty turned out to be useful.
turn out to be（结果是）
paraphrase: I walked away from it all.
Even the strongest search can't save weak raw material.
scenes.speak: I kept notes for six years and used an AI knowledge base deeply for over a year. While everyone was hyping the second brain, I chose to walk away. I saved a thousand notes — fewer than fifty turned out to be useful.

scenes.context: 知识库的问题不是存得不够，而是燃料太差：白纸高认知负荷让人坚持不下去，流水账是没有上下文的死语料。
sentences: 致命缺陷不是存得不够，而是燃料太差。
The fatal flaw isn't how much you store — it's the quality of the fuel.
fatal flaw（致命缺陷）
面对白纸，大脑会瞬间进入高认知负荷。
Facing a blank page, your brain instantly hits a heavy cognitive load.
cognitive load（认知负荷）
这些话没有上下文，就是一句死语料。
Without context, those words are just dead data.
dead data（死语料）
90% 的知识库成为数字坟墓。
90% of knowledge bases end up as digital graveyards.
digital graveyard（数字坟墓）
paraphrase: The base is only as good as the raw material you feed it.
You can find the notes — but nothing in them is alive.
scenes.speak: The fatal flaw isn't how much you store — it's the quality of the fuel. Facing a blank page, your brain instantly hits a heavy cognitive load. Without context, those words are just dead data. 90% of knowledge bases end up as digital graveyards.

scenes.context: 从被动记录转向苏格拉底式引导：取消文件记录和手动整理，只保留对话，让 AI 像心理教练一样反问追问。
sentences: 破局思路：从被动记录转向苏格拉底式的引导。
The pivot: shift from passive logging to Socratic questioning.
Socratic questioning（苏格拉底式提问）
我只保留了一个功能：对话。
I kept only one feature: conversation.
feature（功能）
人天生擅长说话，不擅长写文章。
Humans are born talkers, not writers.
be born to（天生）
它像心理教练一样反问我。
It pushes back like a mental coach.
push back（反问）
paraphrase: It turns your rambling into a guided reflection.
Talking takes almost no friction to start.
scenes.speak: The pivot: shift from passive logging to Socratic questioning. I kept only one feature: conversation. Humans are born talkers, not writers. It pushes back like a mental coach.

scenes.title_cn: 知识库长成树，价值在认知密度
scenes.title_en: The Base Grows Into a Tree
scenes.context: 没有整理动作，知识库长成一棵树；AI 时代比的不是存了多少信息，而是认知被加工到什么密度。
sentences: 没有任何整理动作，知识库竟然长成了一棵树。
With no organizing at all, the base grew into a tree.
grow into（长成）
困惑连着输入，输入连着实验。
Puzzles feed inputs, and inputs feed experiments.
feed（供给、连接）
AI 时代比的不是我存了多少信息。
The AI era isn't about how much information I saved.
the AI era（AI 时代）
而是我的认知被加工到了什么密度。
It's about how dense my thinking has been processed into.
density（密度）
paraphrase: It self-organizes without me touching it.
What matters is how refined the thinking is, not how much you saved.
scenes.speak: With no organizing at all, the base grew into a tree. Puzzles feed inputs, and inputs feed experiments. The AI era isn't about how much information I saved. It's about how dense my thinking has been processed into.

practice.q: 「从被动记录转向苏格拉底式引导」怎么说？
practice.a: Shift from passive logging to Socratic questioning.

pitfalls: Collect notes just to hoard them.
Judge the base by useful fuel, not note count.
A thousand notes with fewer than fifty useful means the material, not the tool, is the problem.
Force yourself to write regularly no matter what.
Lower the friction first — talk to your notes instead.
Blank-page cognitive load makes people quit or fall back to dead journaling.
Rely on AI search to fix weak notes.
Fix the fuel quality, then let search work.
Search can find what you saved, but it can't ignite dead data.
Spend hours on folders and tags.
Let the base self-organize through conversation.
The experiment shows structure can emerge without manual organizing.
shifts: 以前笔记存得越多越好，坚持记流水账，靠 AI 检索补救
现在只保留对话入口，让 AI 反问追问，认知密度成为价值标准
difficult_words: I used an AI knowledge base for over a year.
Everyone was hyping the second brain.
The fatal flaw is the fuel quality.
A blank page hits heavy cognitive load.
Without context, those words are dead data.
Shift from logging to Socratic questioning.
It pushes back like a mental coach.
It's about the density of your thinking.
